newsitem.title: FINLAND: FIM 06 BOND YIELD SEEN 25-30 BPS OVER BUNDS - UNIBANK.
newsitem.headline: FIM 06 BOND YIELD SEEN 25-30 BPS OVER BUNDS - UNIBANK.

text.p: The Finnish long bond yield difference over German Bunds will narrow to 25-30 basis points after the French election, Danish Unibank said in its weekly market report received on Monday.
The report, written before the weekend, had discounted a socialist victory in the French general election on Sunday.
"The spread should trade in a 25-30 bp range after the French election," Unibank said.
The Finnish 2006 bond yield would be heading towards its next support level at 6.33 percent, which "is likely to hold," it said.
Unibank recommended buying Finnish 2006 bonds against equivalent Bunds.
"We ... recommend buying Finnish ten-years against German equivalents at current levels," it said.
In forex markets, Unibank said it expected the DEM/FIM cross to trade in narrow range of 3.01-3.02 this week.
A break through this trading range would rather be through the upper limit at 3.02, it said, spotting a resistance point at 3.0325.
